Background:
<start of reference>

HOLLAND, Mich. (WOOD) — There may be more entrepreneurs soon heading to West Michigan after business experts named Holland the best small city in the nation to start a business.

The tulip-speckled city beat out more than 1,200 other cities to earn the top spot on WalletHub's list, largely due to its access to resources, like investors and higher education assets.

"We're a place that people want to be," City Manager Keith Van Beek told 24 Hour News 8.

He said that support for new businesses is in Holland's "DNA and culture."

"We have a lot of great history and tradition of great ideas that were spawned in garages here that turned into fantastic large companies," Van Beek stated.

Eager entrepreneurs aren't the only people trying to set up shop in Holland.

"We've been trying for about two years to get downtown," said Jake Hogeboom, a broker at @Home Realty. "This was the third or fourth property that we made an offer on."

Hogeboom founded the company in Grand Haven six years ago. Months later, it expanded to the outskirts of Holland. His business outgrew that space and construction will soon wrap up on @Home Realty's new building at the corner of E. 7th Street and College Avenue.

Hogeboom said he's excited to be closer to the downtown energy.

"We love the development, we love what the city's doing (and) what the local developers are doing," he explained.

The company's new downtown location will boast a massive slide, offering transport from the second to first floor. It also features an in-house arcade.

However, the building will be much more than an adult playground. The third floor will transform into a space to support other businesses.

"We'll have 27 offices up there to rent out for smaller local businesses that just need one or two offices, that are looking to grow or start up businesses that can be a part of a building of this capacity but don't have the budget to go and get a big office in this location," Hogeboom explained.

Holland's economic development group, Lakeshore Advantage, seems to have played a big role in its WalletHub ranking. The city's access to investors as well as job growth between 2013 and 2017 helped thrust it to that No. 1 spot.
<end of reference>
Task:
Summarize the main reason why Holland, Michigan is a good place to start a business in at least 5 sentences aimed at high school students.
response_a:
1. Holland, Michigan has a strong entrepreneurial spirit, with a history of successful businesses starting in garages and turning into large companies. This culture supports new businesses and fosters innovation.

2. Access to resources such as investors and higher education assets makes Holland an ideal location for starting a business. These resources provide valuable support and guidance for entrepreneurs.

3. The city's supportive environment and commitment to economic development have led to job growth and a thriving business community. This creates opportunities for new businesses to succeed.

4. Holland's unique character and attractions, such as the tulip-speckled streets and vibrant downtown area, make it an appealing location for businesses that want to stand out and attract customers.

5. The city's proximity to Grand Rapids, a larger metropolitan area, provides additional resources and opportunities for businesses in Holland. This allows businesses to tap into a wider market and access a larger pool of talent and resources.
response_b:

1. Access to Resources: Holland offers excellent access to resources for entrepreneurs, including investors and higher education institutions. This allows aspiring business owners to secure funding and gain valuable knowledge to help their ventures succeed.
2. Strong Business Culture: Holland's business community is thriving, with a strong emphasis on innovation and entrepreneurship. This supportive environment encourages new businesses to take root and grow, contributing to the overall economic health of the city.
3. Diversified Economy: Holland has a diverse economy, with a mix of industries including manufacturing, healthcare, and tourism. This diversity provides opportunities for entrepreneurs to tap into various markets and create products or services that meet the needs of the community.
4. Affordable Cost of Living: Holland offers an affordable cost of living compared to other cities in the region, making it an attractive destination for entrepreneurs looking to start a business without breaking the bank. This lower cost of living can help businesses save money on expenses such as rent, salaries, and supplies.
5. High Quality of Life: Holland is known for its high quality of life, with beautiful parks, excellent schools, and a vibrant arts scene. This makes it an appealing place to live and work, attracting talented individuals who can contribute to the success of local businesses.
